name: London Metropolitan University
description:
Do you want to study at a university rated as being in the top 10 UK universities for teaching quality and student experience, (Sunday Times Good University Guide 2024)?

London Metropolitan University is a multicultural, celebrated university in the heart of the UK capital with competitively priced tuition fees that attract a range of international students. 

The university focuses on preparing students for 96.7% of all London Met graduates who are in work or further study within six months of graduating. 

London Metropolitan University is globally recognised for research and teaching excellence. It was placed third in the HE Innovate Awards 2021 for the most innovative approach to developing employability skills.

Reasons to study at London Metropolitan University

  • 5th in the UK for student satisfaction
  • Top 10 UK university for teaching quality
  • In the top 25% of UK universities for social inclusion
  • Top 15 UK university for overall graduate score

Are you concerned about adapting to life in a new country and academic environment? Do you have questions about whether the university you've selected provides resources tailored to students from diverse backgrounds? Are you curious about whether graduating from this institution will improve your prospects of securing a desirable job on a global scale after graduation?

Discover why London Metropolitan University might just be the place for you!

View courses now

London Metropolitan University dates back to evening classes hosted for young men in Bishopsgate in 1848. The university was formed when the University of North London and London Guildhall University merged in 2002 and hosts more than 12,000 students a year. This includes international students from more than 140 countries.

The university has been recognised in The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2022 where it ranked best in London and sixth in the UK for its teaching quality. The Guardianâ€™s University Guide has placed it in the Top 100 universities in the UK and it has moved into the QS World University Rankings in recent years for the first time.

Student Life

There are lots of opportunities to get involved in student life at London Metropolitan University. You could join in with the student magazine Verve Magazine or Verve Radio. There are more than 50 societies to join as well as sports teams across a wide range of sports.
